lib/models/app_state_snapshot.dart.description: AppStateSnapshot model captures all undoable state for undo/redo system. Uses deep equality (listEquals/mapEquals) for comparing snapshots. Imports ImageAdjustments from processing_provider.dart.

lib/providers/export_provider.dart.description: ExportController now supports cancellation via CancelableOperation from async package. Use isExportingProvider and exportCancelledProvider for UI state binding. Call cancelExport() to cancel ongoing exports. Both exportAll() and exportSingleGeneration() check _isCancelled flag throughout export loops and throw ExportCancelledException when cancelled.

lib/services/export_service.dart.description: ExportService.exportDualBackground() now accepts isCancelled callback for cancellation support. On desktop/mobile, tracks created files/directories and cleans them up via _cleanupPartialExport() when cancelled. Web downloads cannot be reverted once initiated. Uses ExportCancelledException from export_provider.dart.

lib/widgets/undo_redo_buttons.dart.description: UndoRedoButtons is a reusable ConsumerWidget for AppBar actions. It watches canUndoProvider and canRedoProvider for button enabled state. Import from lib/widgets/undo_redo_buttons.dart and use as: const UndoRedoButtons()

lib/main.dart.description: Keyboard shortcuts for undo/redo implemented via Shortcuts and Actions widgets wrapping MaterialApp. Uses UndoIntent/RedoIntent classes with SingleActivator for Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Shift+Z (Windows/Linux) and Command+Z, Command+Shift+Z (macOS). FilamentColorizerApp is a ConsumerWidget to access undoRedoProvider.

test/providers/undo_redo_provider_test.d.description: Unit tests for UndoRedoNotifier covering: initial state, capture/undo/redo operations, history limit enforcement (maxHistorySize=50), clearHistory, state restoration for all providers (images, groups, colorized images, adjustments, selected generations), and derived providers (canUndoProvider, canRedoProvider). Uses ProviderContainer with ImageCacheService override for testing.

test/models/app_state_snapshot_test.dart.description: AppStateSnapshot unit tests covering equality, hashCode, copyWith, empty factory, and deep copy verification. Uses helper functions (createTestImage, createTestGroup, createTestColorizedImage) for test fixtures.
